description.en: Dunkleosteus terrelli. Posterior body, fin outlines, soft tissue and coloration are interpretations. A chosen 3.4 m total length is a working reconstruction, not a settled measured adult size. Do not claim complete fossil preservation or animation readiness.
description.zh: 邓氏鱼的示意性活体复原。后躯、鳍轮廓、软组织及颜色为推定；3.4米总长是工作性复原选择，并非已确定的实测成体尺寸，不宣称完整化石保存或动画就绪。

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: Original muted blue-grey body with restrained lighter underside; color is artistic. No textures.
surface_profile.normal_style: Refined broad planes and coherent surface transitions.

view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect cheap private clay/silhouette views before final renders. Resolve head/armor, gill gap, mouth and fin-root separation first.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB. Perspective and preview may reuse identical bytes.
view_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a local view only for a specific unresolved issue.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website renderer/camera configuration has not been verified during prep. Keep canonical QA directions, do not claim website compatibility, and do not produce 768x432 derivatives here.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static living animal for a prehistoric 3D world; Late Devonian marine use. Not an exhibit mount, scan, rigged swimming character, or exact preserved whole individual.

scientific_limits.en: Posterior body, fin outlines, soft tissue and coloration are interpretations. A chosen 3.4 m total length is a working reconstruction, not a settled measured adult size. Do not claim complete fossil preservation or animation readiness.

scale.basis: Selected interpretation informed by Engelman 2023 length estimates. Keep physical units; never normalize the source GLB to gallery bounds.

pose.description: Neutral swimming posture with gently parted mouth; no embedded water, seabed, museum supports or labels. Static body, no claimed locomotion.

morphology.obligation: Integrated armored head and deep anterior trunk; paired gnathal cutting plates instead of rows of shark teeth; separate head/trunk joint and intervening gill opening.
Deep compact trunk, anterior pectoral origins and narrow tail base. Follow reference silhouette rather than a stretched shark body.
Fin outlines and posterior body remain explicitly inferred; balance the reconstruction, avoid claiming fossil-exact tail shape.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Use inherited ceilings as ceilings, not density targets. Allocate triangles to head silhouette, mouth separation and coherent fin roots; no hidden skeleton.

art_direction.construction: Continuous original lofted body and attached fins; readable armor transitions without mechanical seams. No borrowed reference texture pixels.

world_use.role: Large marine animal for a Late Devonian underwater region
world_use.placement: Separate animal asset, no environment baked in; world controls water depth, movement and spawn scale. Do not imply coexistence with Early Devonian Erbenochile or Cambrian taxa merely because all are marine.
world_use.integration_boundary: No rig, collision proxy, LOD or runtime swim behavior is promised by this static brief. Scene needs must be checked against world PR before those are added.

acceptance_obligations: Distinct animal silhouette and anatomical brief compliance in four exact-GLB views.
Portable embedded GLB, source reopening and scoped technical checks; independent review separate.
Mark GPU, world scene, user acceptance and deployment unverified until actually checked.
